info.name: Nexeno Theme
info.summary: A modern light and dark look for Nextcloud, chosen by each user, across Files, Photos, Talk, Calendar and more.
info.description:
**Nexeno theme gives Nextcloud a clean, modern look in the Nexeno brand colours, in a light and a dark variant.**
Each user decides for themselves: the theme is off until a user turns it on, and turning it off brings back their own Nextcloud appearance settings, which the theme never changes.
### What Nexeno theme does
- **Light and Dark** – two variants in the Nexeno brand colours. Users switch them on under *Personal settings → Appearance and accessibility*, and the choice follows them on every device. - **The whole interface** – restyled navigation, header menus, dialogs, sidebars, search, settings pages and the app store. - **Your everyday apps** – tailored layouts for Files, Photos, Dashboard, Activity, Calendar, Contacts, Deck, Notes, Tasks, Talk, Collectives, Teams, Text, Mail and Office. - **Login page** – the sign-in page uses the Nexeno look for every visitor. - **Accessibility kept** – the OpenDyslexic font stays on for users who chose it. - **Nexeno apps keep their design** – Nexeno apps such as Nexeno Project have their own built-in design, and the theme leaves them unchanged. - **Your language** – available in English, German, French, Dutch, Italian, Spanish, Swedish, Polish and Portuguese (Brazil).
### Privacy
The theme runs fully inside your Nextcloud and loads nothing from outside services. It stores one setting per user, the chosen variant, which is included when the user exports their account with Nextcloud's account migration.
### Requirements
- Nextcloud 32, 33, 34 or 35. - No background jobs, email server or extra apps are needed.
